description: Reproduce and reconcile Hermes runtime home and additive shared skills

acceptanceCriteria: Record image digest, upstream revision, installer checksum, UID, cwd, home variables and executable path.
Prove no host binds, socket, credentials or published ports.
Install through oh as sandbox and demonstrate actual upstream home and skill discovery failure before repair.
If baseline passes, request missing reproduction details rather than invent a fix.
Tests pass

acceptanceCriteria: Keep program in ~/.local/lib/hermes-agent and runtime default in ~/harness/.hermes.

Tests pass

userStories.title: Verify install postconditions
userStories.description: As an operator, I want success only after integration succeeds.
acceptanceCriteria: Reconcile fresh and already-installed paths through existing execution target.

Tests pass

acceptanceCriteria: Copy candidate artifacts into disposable containers only and record identities.

Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Real smoke passes before/after restart and retained-volume recreation; state hashes unchanged. Copied payload works without Claude scaffold; real host binds explicitly excluded.

userStories.title: Add repeatable regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want automation to detect the original defect.
acceptanceCriteria: Add focused integration assertions, safety tests and relevant CI coverage.
Baseline or fault injection fails new assertion and candidate passes.

Tests pass
Typecheck passes
